verdict.rationale: A bank-data aggregation product could plausibly offer an end-user consent portal, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents account linking, Link save-and-reuse across Stripe businesses, data access (balances, ownership, transactions), webhooks and a relink API. None of it describes a user-facing surface for viewing or revoking which apps hold access to bank data, so there is no evidence for this story.

support.subject: As an ops lead, end users can see and revoke what they've shared — a documented consent surface or portal where a user manages which apps hold access to their bank data
